Style: industrial, contemporary, modern
Materials: oak veneer with visible grain, brushed nickel metal base, metal bar pulls
Colors: medium warm brown oak, brushed silver

Feel: sleek, warm, urban
Goes with: grey or white walls, concrete, chrome accents; industrial or modern bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glenwood Industrial Metal Dresser, 60"W, Oak
product.description: This industrial double dresser features robust metal pulls on its six drawers and a matching metal piece on the bottom. Solid hardwood construction is finished with quarter-sawn oak veneer and wire-brushed for a distressed look. 60"W x 19"D x 35"H Solid hardwood with oak veneer and metal drawer pulls A bold industrial design is softened by a classic wood finish to blend with modern décor. Self-closing drawers are suspended on concealed ball-bearing extension glides. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
